HavStrategy is a data-driven digital marketing and performance growth agency serving D2C, ecommerce, fashion, lifestyle, beauty and luxury brands. We combine creativity with analytics to deliver measurable results.

We're hiring a UGC Content Creator to produce authentic, creator-style videos and photos that look native to social platforms and drive conversions. You'll appear on camera or create faceless content, demonstrate products, and deliver ad-ready UGC for our client brands' organic and paid campaigns.

Follow creative briefs and brand guidelines while keeping the content natural and authentic

Coordinate with the social media, design and performance teams on content requirements and timelines

Review basic performance data (views, watch time, CTR, engagement) and suggest improvements

1-2 years of experience creating UGC, short-form video or influencer-style content (portfolio required)

Comfortable on camera, with clear delivery and natural expressions

Good understanding of Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and ad creative formats

Basic video editing skills using CapCut, InShot, VN or similar apps

Own smartphone with a good camera, plus basic lighting and a mic

Ability to adapt tone across brands, from playful D2C to premium luxury

Reliability on deadlines and comfort working in a fast-paced environment

Core Skills Needed

Content & Creative Skills

UGC video creation (reviews, demos, testimonials, unboxings)

Hook writing and short-form scripting

On-camera presence and voiceovers

Product styling and basic photography

Storytelling for ads and organic content

Tools & Technical Skills

CapCut, InShot, VN or Adobe Premiere Rush

Canva (basic)

Instagram, Meta Business Suite and YouTube Studio

Basic lighting, framing and audio setup

Google Drive / Sheets for file delivery and tracking

Industry/Domain Knowledge

Awareness of current social trends, sounds and formats

Understanding of what makes UGC convert in paid ads

Exposure to beauty, fashion, lifestyle and D2C brand communication (preferred)

Soft Skills

Creativity and confidence

Attention to detail

Time management and ownership

Openness to feedback and collaboration

Preferred Skills

Experience creating UGC for paid ad campaigns

Basic knowledge of content analytics and A/B testing creatives

Prior work with beauty, fashion or D2C brands

Existing audience or creator profile (nice to have, not mandatory)

How to Apply

Send your CV along with 3-5 UGC samples or links (Reels, ad creatives, product videos, testimonials) and your Instagram or portfolio link.

description:
**Your Next** **Opportunity** **Starts Here**
---------------------------------------------

Join a team that's shaping the future of Advertising & Beyond. At Xapads, you'll work alongside people who challenge convention, embrace innovation, and build AI-powered technologies that help brands connect with audiences across the globe. Whether you're an engineer, marketer, strategist, or storyteller, your ideas have the opportunity to make a real impact. We believe great work is driven by curious minds, collaborative teams, and the freedom to build what's next.

**Please apply safely.** Xapads only communicates recruitment opportunities through our official Careers page and verified **@xapads.com** addresses. We never ask for payments or fees as part of our hiring process. If you receive any suspicious communication or would like to verify a job opportunity, please contact us at career@xapads.com.

  

**Job Information**
-------------------

* Date Opened 10/13/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry Ad Operations
* City Noida
* State/Province Uttar Pradesh
* Country India
* Zip/Postal Code 201301

**Job Description**
-------------------

**JOB TITLE**

**Campaign Manager – YouTube Expert**

  

**Location**: Headquarters – Noida, India

**Experience**: 7–8 Years (exclusively in YouTube advertising)

**Department**: Ad Operations – Branding Department

**Segment**: Pulse (Contextual Targeting & Brand Safety)

  

**ABOUT XAPADS MEDIA**

Xapads Media is a global ad-tech leader providing AI-driven, programmatically unified advertising solutions across branding and performance channels. Operating across key global markets including India, UAE, Russia, Singapore, Indonesia, US, UK, and Germany, Xapads empowers agencies and global brands with privacy-first, cookie-less targeting and advanced campaign activation. Through intelligent platforms like Pulse and Xaprio, Xapads seamlessly bridges audience engagement and brand safety across video, connected TV (CTV), display, and mobile ecosystems.

**ABOUT THE SEGMENT**

Pulse is Xapads’ proprietary AI-powered contextual targeting and brand safety/suitability platform built for YouTube advertising. By analyzing video frames, audio, emotions, and metadata in real time, Pulse delivers GARM-compliant brand protection and contextual placement precision across Google Ads and Display & Video 360 (DV360).

  

**THE ROLE**

The Campaign Manager – YouTube Expert exists to strengthen and scale YouTube campaign execution across global markets for Xapads' Pulse product. Sitting within the Ad Operations - Branding team, you will own end-to-end strategy, setup, pacing, optimization, and measurement across Google Ads and DV360. The role bridges brand awareness with direct performance outcomes (ROAS, conversions, appinstalls), utilizing Pulse’s contextual intelligence capabilities to achieve client key performance indicators (KPIs) while maintaining strict brand safety standards.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

**Campaign Delivery:** Own campaign setup, daily run rates, pacing, budget allocation, and delivery quality across assigned YouTube accounts.

**Performance & Optimization:** Own campaign performance diagnosis, bidding strategies, and multi-KPI optimization across both branding and performance objectives.

**Pulse Integration:** Own the execution and tactical implementation of Pulse’s contextual targeting, brand safety, and brand suitability layers within live campaign workflows.

**Measurement & Reporting:** Own campaign reporting, attribution analysis, and post-campaign insights across Google Ads and DV360.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**Campaign Setup & Activation:** Plan, configure, and launch complex YouTube campaigns through both Google Ads and DV360, utilizing line items, insertion orders, and ad groups.

**Format & Inventory Management:** Execute campaigns across diverse YouTube ad formats including skippable in-stream, non-skippable in-stream, bumper ads, in-feed, YouTube Shorts, connected TV (CTV), and high-impact placements.

**Performance Driving:** Implement visual-first Demand Gen and cross-channel Performance Max(PMax) strategies to drive performance outcomes such as cost per acquisition (CPA), return on ad spend (ROAS), and app installs.

**Contextual & Brand Safety Execution:** Deploy Pulse’s AI-powered contextual filters, GARM-compliant exclusion lists, and custom safe-lists to maximize ad relevance and maintain suitability.

**Attribution & Measurement:** Analyze conversion tracking, post-impression installs,engaged-view conversions (EVC), and view-through conversions (VTC) to evaluate full-funnel video influence.

**Policy & Compliance Troubleshooting:** Diagnose and resolve platform approval bottlenecks,restricted content categories, and Google YouTube policy compliance issues.

**Reporting & Analysis:** Prepare actionable performance reports for internal teams and clients, highlighting view-through rate (VTR), video completion rate (VCR), cost per view (CPV), and conversion metrics.

  

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**7–8 Years of Dedicated Experience:** Minimum 7–8 years of direct, hands-on experience managing YouTube ad campaigns.

**Dual-Platform Proficiency:** Proven expertise in operating YouTube campaigns natively across both Google Ads and DV360 (YouTube & Partners line items).

**Full-Funnel Campaign Ownership:** Demonstrated experience managing both reach/awareness (CPM, VTR, VCR) and performance/conversion campaigns (tCPA, tROAS, CVR, app installs).

**Advanced Campaign Formats:** Hands-on experience with Demand Gen and Performance Max (PMax) campaign setup, video asset strategy, and performance optimization.

**Attribution & Tracking Knowledge:** Practical understanding of Google Ads conversion tracking,Floodlight pixels, engaged-view conversions (EVC), view-through conversions (VTC), and attribution windows.

**Policy & Operations:** Working knowledge of Google advertising policies, campaign approval workflows, and troubleshooting restricted or sensitive ad categories.

  

**GOOD TO HAVE**

**Leadership Capability:** Experience mentoring or guiding junior team members while operating as an individual contributor.

**Multi-Market Exposure:** Experience managing multi-region or global YouTube campaign portfolios.

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

**Independent Execution:** Independently manages YouTube campaigns across Google Ads and DV360.

**KPI Consistency & Efficiency:** Consistently meets agreed client delivery targets and demonstrates measurable improvements in campaign efficiency, ROAS, and completion rates.

**Pulse Integration:** Seamlessly integrates Pulse’s AI contextual targeting and brand suitability capabilities into daily campaign workflows to maximize ad relevance.

  

**HOW TO APPLY**

Interested candidates can apply directly by sharing their updated resume with the HR team at career@xapads.com or visiting www.xapads.com/careers.

We’re looking for an experienced Technical Product Manager to own our Jobs platform and take its capabilities to the next level. Your responsibilities would span the entire pipeline from ingestion, cleansing, and indexing of jobs as they come in; through searching and matching for both users in real\-time and offline notifications; to providing front\-end product interfaces to our web property product managers. All of this needs to happen at scale across our ecosystem of many millions of jobs and job seekers.



This is an interdisciplinary role emphasizing breadth and orchestration across architecture, data engineering and science, development, analytics, and product management. A technical background is desirable and we expect a firm grasp of technical capabilities and concepts. You’ll at the very least be able to ‘read API’. However, more important is the ability to work with multiple teams to come up with a mix that works \- and works well \- for the end user. Key skills here are a strong analytical bent of mind for defining key metrics/benchmarks and measuring at scale, as well as the ability to hone in on the individual job seeker and answer the right questions: is her need being met? If not, how can we improve?



**Job Description**
-------------------


**ABOUT THIS TEAM**



BOLD Platform services team design, creates, manage and maintains the highly scalable and distributed services for the wider use of web and mobile product applications/portals/websites. The current list of services is based on Microservices architecture whose domain ranges from visitor tracking, User profiles, authentication, content and payments.



Platform team uses state of the art modern technologies like .Net framework, Python, Java, SQL Server, My SQL, Graph DB, SOLR, and a lot of other tools \& technologies serving millions of users with hundreds of million transactions everyday through a scalable and fault tolerant architecture.


**WHAT YOU’LL DO**


* Work closely with North America product leadership to understand jobs product needs and use cases.
* Work closely with senior engineering management and architecture to plot the technical vision and roadmap for the platform.
* Design, implement, and support, in cooperation with other data teams and data scientists a platform to measure our jobs quality, coverage, and relevancy through manual and automatic mechanisms.
* Analyse and measure the quality and coverage of vendor feeds.
* Measure and improve our job recommendations and search capabilities.
* Work with internal teams to build dashboards which will be used by internal stakeholders (product, office of the CEO, analytics etc).
* Measure and improve jobs data quality to point out issues with jobs data/gaps with jobs data.
* Work with the data science team to build jobs evaluation ML models.
* Evaluate jobs data coverage for jobs within the BOLD system.
* Translate business requirements and develop an end to end solution.
* Design web\-scale products following best coding principles, optimized coding practices and using open source tools \& platforms.
* Proactively identify potential problems and opportunities to improve the data pipelines related to jobs data.


**WHAT YOU’LL NEED**


* Experience in the jobs domain with a good understanding of jobs, job matching, jobs recommendations.
* Proven track record of taking ownership, thinking strategically, and successfully delivering results in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Possess an understanding of technology stacks and level of efforts involved in order to be able to make right decisions.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with demonstrated experience engaging and influencing senior executives.
* Strong attention to detail and proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to use data and metrics to back up assumptions, recommendations and drive actions.
* Engineering/ Master’s Degree from a good Institute (preferably Computer Science or related).


 **EXPERIENCE\-**

* Annual Appraisal

As an established global organization, BOLD helps people find jobs. Our story is one of growth, success, and professional fulfillment. description:
**Job Description: Media Planning Manager**

**Role Summary:\-**

Bakson Group is looking for a strategic and results\-driven Media Planning Manager to lead the social media team and manage integrated advertising and branding initiatives for Sunny and Bakson Medicines.

The role will be responsible for audience research, campaign strategy, media planning, budget allocation, brand development, and performance optimisation across digital and offline channels. The candidate will work closely with creative, product, sales, medical, and external agency teams to deliver consistent and effective brand communication.

**Key Responsibilities:\-**

**1\. Social Media Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and manage the social media team.
* Develop platform\-specific social media strategies and content calendars.
* Oversee content creation, design, copywriting, publishing, and community engagement.
* Ensure consistent brand messaging across all social media platforms.
* Monitor social media performance and guide the team in improving reach, engagement, leads, and conversions.
* Establish workflows, timelines, and performance goals for the team.

**2\. Advertising Campaign Planning**

* Design integrated advertising campaigns aligned with the company’s business and brand objectives.
* Develop campaign briefs covering objectives, target audiences, messaging, channels, budgets, and timelines.
* Plan campaigns across social media, search, display, video, influencer marketing, print, outdoor, retail, and events.
* Coordinate campaign development from initial concept through execution and performance review.
* Test different audiences, creatives, messages, and media formats to improve campaign effectiveness.

**3\. Media Planning and Budget Allocation**

* Prepare annual, quarterly, and campaign\-level media plans.
* Allocate advertising budgets across appropriate digital channels based on campaign objectives and expected returns.
* Recommend the right mix of paid, owned, and earned media.
* Monitor media spending and optimise budgets according to campaign performance.
* Track metrics including reach, impressions, engagement, leads, conversions, cost per lead, and return on advertising spend.
* Prepare regular budget utilisation and campaign performance reports for management.

**4\. Online and Offline Branding**

* Develop and implement branding strategies for Sunny and Bakson Medicines.
